ui_bugs.issue: Invalid HTML nesting: application-content-link-<id> is an <a> rendered inside the campaign React-Router <Link> (also <a>). Triggers React dev warning 'In HTML, <a> cannot be a descendant of <a>. This will cause a hydration error.' Behaviourally the onClick=stopPropagation works, but move the content link OUTSIDE the campaign <Link> (e.g. into the action column beside submit-content-btn, or replace the outer Link with a div + programmatic navigation) to fix the nesting.

action_items: Fix invalid <a>-inside-<a> nesting for application-content-link (see frontend_issues.ui_bugs). Recommend restructuring row so the campaign Link no longer wraps the meta strip containing the content link, OR move the content-link into the action column beside submit-content-btn.
Update stale test_admin.py::TestStateMachine::test_advance_from_in_payment_moves_to_closed_without_paying to expect 400 (advance from in_payment is now blocked — use mark_paid).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py=1790 lines, Dashboard.jsx=864 lines — both above the 700-line split threshold. New SubmitContentDialog + ApplicationsSection refactor is a good candidate to extract into components/creator/SubmitContentDialog.jsx and components/creator/ApplicationsSection.jsx.

SubmitContentPayload uses Field(min_length=8) — an 8-char minimum is not enough to guarantee http://x (which is exactly 8 chars). Consider min_length=10 or dropping min_length and relying only on the http/https prefix check, which is the actually meaningful invariant.

Backend accepts ANY URL starting with http/https (e.g. 'https://malicious.example.com/x'); if the intent per problem-statement is 'published Instagram URL', consider validating the host is instagram.com. Not a blocker but worth confirming with product.

Frontend row now uses `<Link>` for campaign + sibling action column — but the content link (which appears once content_url is set) is nested INSIDE the Link and relies on e.stopPropagation() + being an <a target=_blank>. This yields invalid nested-<a> HTML (see frontend_issues.ui_bugs). The cleaner fix is to make the outer campaign area a non-anchor click target (Card+useNavigate) OR to move the content link out.

SubmitContentDialog resets `url` from collab.content_url on open — that means if a creator previously submitted, the field is prefilled. But the backend blocks a re-submit with 400 (state is now content_submitted), so this prefill can never be used. Either hide the button for content_url-set rows (already done via isAttended gate) or drop the prefill logic to reduce dead code.

The client-side pattern /^https?:\/\//i accepts a scheme-only string like 'https://'; if a user pastes only that, backend still accepts (len>=8, prefix matches) and stores an empty-post URL. Add a stricter regex like /^https?:\/\/.+\..+/i.
No rate-limit or debounce on submit — a creator could double-click the button; setBusy(true) protects the same click but a fast repeat after error could race. Minor.
